name: TRIREME Battery Safety Training
summary:
Step into your first day on the factory floor with this educational VR experience.
Guided by a unreliable narrator, you will learn by experiencing safety risks at first hand to build your confidence before entering a real production setting.

Designed for manufacturing onboarding, the game guides players through essential workplace hazards and personal protective equipment requirements in a battery assembly plant.
